steps: Trim surrounding whitespace (registration already trims and limits locale to 32 characters).
Take the primary subtag before the first hyphen or underscore.
Match one of the nine locale keys; missing, empty or unsupported values use en.
normalization.selection: Use the device registration locale read for each delivery attempt, not the locale at event enqueue time. Completed registrations are not resent after locale or token updates.
